description: ARGUS-X real-video ground-truth annotations for multi-camera identity recovery evaluation.

required_fields: timestamp (float: seconds from start of that video)
gt_identity_id (str: e.g. 'PERSON_A', 'PERSON_B' — MUST be identical across cameras for the same physical person)
bbox (list[float]: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixel coordinates)
instructions.workflow: Run './venv/bin/streamlit run evaluation/annotate_app.py' to annotate frames interactively and save here, then validate with './venv/bin/python -m evaluation.annotation_validator --require-non-empty'.
